process.heading: How an Edstellar executive coaching program runs.
process.description: Six steps take each executive from nomination to a final summary they control, over six to eight months. Your CHRO sees progress at every step; the coaching itself stays between executive and coach.

steps.label: Nominate the executive
steps.title: Nominate the executive
steps.description: Your CHRO or program admin adds the executive on Meridian with their role, objective and focus areas. The executive agrees to take part.

steps.label: Match an executive coach
steps.title: Match an executive coach
steps.description: In a 30-minute video session, the executive reviews the certified coaches Meridian recommends and chooses one. The CHRO can join this session if the executive wants them there.

steps.label: Chemistry session
steps.title: Chemistry session
steps.description: A free 30-minute session to test the fit, confirm the objective, choose one of the six executive tracks and agree the schedule.
steps.who: Executive and coach · live on video

steps.label: Coaching sessions
steps.title: Coaching sessions
steps.description: Ten to twelve hours of one-on-one coaching on Meridian. The executive sets the focus, the coach prepares, and an assignment carries the work forward.
steps.who: Executive and coach · live on video

steps.label: Mid-point check-in
steps.title: Mid-point check-in
steps.description: Halfway through, executive and coach review progress against the objective and adjust the plan for the hours ahead.
steps.who: Executive and coach · live on video

steps.label: Final review and summary
steps.title: Final review and summary
steps.description: The final session agrees what the executive will keep doing, and the executive chooses what the CHRO sees in the final summary.

items.question: What is executive coaching?
items.answer: Executive coaching is one-on-one professional coaching for CEOs, CXOs and senior leaders, focused on the decisions, relationships and pressures that come with leading at the top. Edstellar's executive coaching pairs each executive with a certified coach for ten to twelve hours over six to eight months, run on Meridian.

items.question: Who is executive coaching for?
items.answer: Executive coaching is for CEOs and CXOs, newly appointed executives in their first year, successors being prepared for top roles, and senior leaders facing a restructure, merger, turnaround or new investor.

items.question: How long does an executive coaching engagement last?
items.answer: Ten to twelve hours of one-on-one coaching over six to eight months. The session length and schedule are agreed in the free chemistry session.

items.question: What certifications do Edstellar executive coaches hold?
items.answer: Every Edstellar executive coach is certified by the International Coaching Federation (ICF) at PCC or MCC level, the International Coaching Community (ICC) or the European Mentoring and Coaching Council (EMCC). Coaches are also vetted by Edstellar before Meridian can recommend them.

items.question: How does Edstellar match an executive with a coach?
items.answer: Meridian recommends certified coaches based on the executive's track, objective, language and time zone. In a 30-minute video session the executive reviews the recommendations and chooses one, then meets the coach in a free chemistry session before anyone commits.

items.question: What does our organization see during executive coaching?
items.answer: Your CHRO sees sessions held, hours used, progress against the agreed objective and the parts of the final summary the executive chooses to share. Session content, notes and assignments stay between executive and coach.

items.question: What are the six executive coaching tracks?
items.answer: Executive Presence, Strategic Decision-Making, Leading Through Change, Influence & Stakeholders, Board & Investor Relationships and Resilience at the Top. The executive chooses one with the coach in the chemistry session.

items.question: Is executive coaching delivered virtually?
items.answer: Yes. Edstellar delivers executive coaching virtually on Meridian, with every session on video and executives seeing times in their own time zone. Language and time zone are part of how coaches are matched.
